mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition to be met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A reading of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of unemployment (UNRATE) is associated with reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition to be met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 5 trading days compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 5 days, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 60 days signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases over 60 days, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
